grok_lane_equilibrium.rule: highest rung beating the BEST PREVIOUS rung on ACCEPTED per hour by more than 5%. All rungs are scanned; the series is non-monotonic and a rule that stopped at the first decline reported equilibrium 1 for a fleet still gaining at 12.

machine_genome.active_decode_reason: k=3 gained only -1.9% over k=2, within the 0.2% noise floor -> saturated

c8.reason: c=8 is not physically meaningful on this box: one shared body is already bandwidth-bound (GPU_LEDGER 468.9 GB/s streaming 13.62 GB/token). NOETIC_MULTISESSION concurrent_independent scaled 1.000 -> 1.325 -> 1.323; c=4 did not beat c=2. Extra streams past the memory-system delivery limit split the same tokens, stretch TTFT, and cannot raise verified WUs/hour.

winner.why: A configuration with lower aggregate tok/s can win if it verifies more WorkUnits per wall second (less truncation, fewer unusable answers, better TTFT so the same token budget closes </think>).

contradicts_the_machine_genome.note: ~/.config/hcli/machine_genome.json understates the limit (2 vs a measured 4) and overstates what two decoders buy (1.1934 claimed vs 1.105 measured). The genome was not edited: it is the operator's qualified profile, and changing it is a separate decision.

finding.detail: On the 5-slot pool the ladder reads 22.489 / 24.839 / 26.050 / 28.422 / 28.259 tok/s aggregate for c=1..5, i.e. 1.000 / 1.105 / 1.159 / 1.264 / 1.257. Aggregate peaks at FOUR concurrent decodes and goes DOWN at five. Concurrency is a real but small lever here: four decoders buy 26% over one, not 4x.

DRAM_BYTES_PER_TOKEN.note: Weight stream + activation writes + rec/conv/KV reads + GEMV X reads at seq_len=42. Not a GPU DRAM counter (that is ABSENT). Rank this with ACTIVE_BYTES above stored size.

DRAM_READ_BYTES.absent_reason: MTLDevice.counterSets on this Apple M3 Ultra contains only the 'timestamp' set with counter ['GPUTimestamp']. There is no DRAM bytes-moved, cache, or occupancy counter. Apple GPU does not expose NVIDIA-style Nsight bandwidth counters via the public Metal API.

GPU_IDLE_GAPS_NS.absent_reason: Production is one mixed command buffer. Intra-CB idle between the 964 dispatches sits inside GPUEndTime−GPUStartTime and cannot be split: supportsCounterSampling.atDispatchBoundary=False (false). TCB production identity refuses ComputePassDescriptor boundary samples because they changed greedy token ids. wait_minus_gpu is host queue wait, not intra-CB GPU idle — see GPU_QUEUE_WAIT_NS.

q80_anchor.note: Qwen3-80B MoE mixed decode, many CBs, host router readback. Sealed prior, not re-derived.

value.reading: Q80 sat at 0.79% of a 700.0 GB/s ceiling with 51.0% GPU idle because it was dispatch-bound across many CBs. The q4 incumbent is 1 CB / 964 dispatches, streams 468.9 GB/s (67.0% of 700, 78.7% of the 595.9 GB/s sequential roof) with GPU occupying 95.6% of complete-wall. Host queue wait is 1.39% of wall, not 51.0%. Applying the Q80 idle diagnosis to this vehicle is false. The remaining lever is ACTIVE BYTES per token (and encoder/dispatch ceremony), not 'the GPU is idle'.

MTLResidencySet_wired.absent_reason: metal 0.29 / objc2-metal 0.2 do not bind MTLResidencySet. Wired residency where it applies was approximated with MTLResourceStorageModePrivate | HazardTrackingModeUntracked and setPurgeableState(NonVolatile).

OS_PAGE_CACHE_COLD_GB_S.absent_reason: A true disk-cold run requires dropping the kernel page cache. This session cannot sudo purge. GPU fill already walks the working set, so OS-page-cache cold is not the quantity. Graph/cache-cold first GPU dispatch after fill IS measured.

hardware_DRAM_counter.absent_reason: Apple GPU performance counters on this box do not expose a DRAM-read byte counter the campaign can sample (GPU_LEDGER already records this). Bytes moved are the unique-once (or declared load-count) accounting of the kernel, not a hardware DRAM probe.

per_dispatch_gpu_ns_inside_one_cb.absent_reason: atDispatchBoundary sampling is unsupported on this device. Concurrent-CB aggregate uses min(GPUStart) / max(GPUEnd) across completed command buffers.

correction.note: 595.9 contradicted. DRAM sequential unique-once roof is 778.8 GB/s (4 GiB, float4, tg=256, groups=4096, private, 1 CB). A 1 GiB unique-once at 1131.8 GB/s exceeds datasheet peak and is not the roof.

answer.evidence: Highest measured GPU DRAM read is 778.8 GB/s on sequential|f4|tg256|g4096|ws4294967296|it2|st16|read|private|nb1|q1; 775 GB/s is REACHABLE (this config).
answer.one_gib_unique_once_exceeds_datasheet: 1 GiB sequential unique-once with iters=2 measured ~1132 GB/s, above the 819 GB/s datasheet. The second pass is cached. Excluded from the DRAM roof (DRAM roof requires >= 4 GiB unique-once and GB/s <= 1.05 × 819).
answer.strided_load_count_is_not_dram: Strided kernels with overlapping per-thread windows report 1e3+ TB/s because the same cache lines are reloaded. That is not DRAM unique-once and is not used for the roof or the 775 verdict.
